242:t_1:59.en:
$n
「I don't know how that mysterious space and the black $$アンゲロイ$$... and the $$テンシ$$ I've been chasing... are connected...」

242:t_1:60.en:
$$アマタ$$
「If the $$血塗られた眼$$ still showed up, does that mean $$ガドライト#pilot$$ wasn't the enemy who took your family, $n...?」

242:t_1:61.en:
$n
「I half expected it... I can't say $$ガドライト#pilot$$ and the $$テンシ$$ are unrelated in my mind, but somewhere I always felt a gap between them.」

242:t_1:62.en:
$n
「Besides, the $$血塗られた眼$$ showed up at $$ラース・バビロン$$ too... There's surely some connection between the $$テンシ$$ and $$サイデリアル$$, but right now we have no way to pursue it...」

242:t_1:64.en:
$n
「Sorry for worrying you. But... I'm fine.」

242:t_1:66.en:
$n
「I've managed somehow up to now. It'll be the same from here on.」

242:t_1:68.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But in the fight in that space, I feel like I came to understand a little about your $$血塗られた眼$$, $n...」

242:t_1:69.en:
$$甲児$$
「Me too. ...So that's how you always fight.」

242:t_1:71.en:
$n
「But even I got through it somehow. If it's you guys, that thing will never crush you.」

242:t_1:72.en:
$$アルト$$
「Listen to you. Figures, from the first one to shake off the sullen act.」

242:t_1:74.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We gave $n such high-and-mighty advice, so now we have to pull it off ourselves.」

242:t_1:75.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Anyway, he says himself there's nothing to worry about, so he should be fine now.」

242:t_1:77.en:
$$ハサン$$
「That's fine, but shouldn't you say a word to Miss $$スズネ$$?」

242:t_1:80.en:
$n
「S-Sorry, Miss $$スズネ$$! I... didn't know you'd been watching over me...!」

242:t_1:81.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't worry about it. More importantly, take care of yourself.」

242:t_1:84.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's like the $$時獄戦役$$ all over again...」

242:t_1:85.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It's true that things have been rough ever since the assault on $$ラース・バビロン$$, but...」

242:t_1:86.en:
$n
「...But we now have a prospect of getting back to Earth.」

242:t_1:87.en:
$$アルト$$
「From Jupiter, a few Folds will get us back to Earth space.」

242:t_1:88.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's odd to say we owe it to being thrown to the galactic center, but we also got hold of information on the universe's collapse.」

242:t_1:89.en:
$$シン$$
「And on the $$サイデリアル$$ trump card too.」

242:t_1:90.en:
$n
「We return to Earth and pay the $$新地球皇国$$ back.」

242:t_1:91.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And then we fight $$バアル$$.」

242:t_1:92.en:
$$甲児$$
「We've got plenty to do. We have no time to lose to despair or fear.」

242:t_1:94.en:
$n
(Wait for me, $$宗介$$... We'll be back on Earth soon.)

242:t_1:95.en:
$n
(I'm counting on you all being safe...)

242:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A worried face really suits a beauty, $$セツコ$$.」

242:t_10:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I'm sorry. I can't play along with your jokes.」

242:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So even my once-in-a-lifetime confession got taken for a joke, did it?」

242:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As I thought, it's still bothering you. That mysterious space.」

242:t_10:9.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The woman who appeared at the end... She spoke to me through the $$スフィア$$.」

242:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A mystery is a mystery, after all. Racking our brains here won't take us beyond guesswork.」

242:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「More to the point, what makes me happy is that we managed to wipe out that army of terror.」

242:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... got so carried away that I ended up producing a $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z all by myself. Of course, I added it to the unit's stock.」

242:t_10:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Even at a time like this, AG is all about $$Ｚチップ$$, aren't you?」

242:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally! That's what a dimensional merchant is all about!」

242:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Yes... And that is precisely our last hope.)

242:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As I thought, the $$血塗られた眼$$ is still bothering you.」

242:t_10:23.en:
$n
「About that, it's as I told $$アルト$$ and the others. There's nothing I can make out at this point...」

242:t_10:24.en:
$n
「So I'll just deal with what's in front of me, one thing at a time.」

242:t_10:26.en:
$n
「I can manage my own problems myself. The problem is...」

242:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Who knows... She's not the troublesome student she used to be, after all...」

242:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a man, why not fill the gap in her heart for her...!」

242:t_10:31.en:
$n
「I was a fool to ask you.」

242:t_10:33.en:
$n
「If I stay here, I'll end up stuck minding the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ shop.」

242:t_10:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Finding hope in any despair... How touching they are, the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

242:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It depends on the person. $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ drew out the power of his $$スフィア$$ through anger and resignation, after all.」

242:t_10:40.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't care about a dead man. What matters is what comes next.」

242:t_10:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everything has started moving... toward the true collapse that comes once every 120 million years...」

242:t_10:43.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The moment we return to Earth is the beginning of the end, then...」

242:t_10:45.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Until then, keep putting your heart into your business.」

242:t_10:46.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course! Then let's give it our all again today... business, business!」
